name: Gildan Softstyle Jersey T-shirt
productInfo:
This Gildan Softstyle Jersey T‑shirt represents the best of Gildan embracing their softer side. It's a midweight, 4.5 oz. ringspun cotton tee, surprisingly soft to be so easy on your group's event budget. And it's available in the Gildan line-up of colors. (The proverbial box of crayons you begged for as a kid, i.e. more than 50!) And speaking of kids, we have custom t-shirts in sizes for them, teens, and adults.

Updated to fit today's fashion, the shoulder seam on these Gildan Softstyle Jersey T-shirts has been moved slightly forward to take advantage of your body's natural position and increase comfort. In addition to being ultra comfy, these soft t-shirts feature a seamless collar with a tear-away label. It's like they asked, "Which bits on t-shirts make people uncomfortable?" And then they completely deconstructed the t-shirt of old to make way for something far more advanced.

Need a comfy shirt personalized for your next event? Just upload your design or let us help you create the perfect graphic in our Design Lab. Whether you need just a few or a few hundred, we can make your next reunion, wedding reception, fundraiser, convention, or party memorable even after the event with these tees as souvenirs. Be sure to check the Sizing Line-Up℠ before you commit to sizes!
